Name: Casimir Metohijac

Awareness.name: The Forbidden Delight
Awareness.description: Acquired a taste for human flesh, sensing its presence, getting intoxicated by its taste, gaining insights on your prey.

Heritage.name: Tread the path lost to mankind
Heritage.description: Paths open for you in the wild.

Heritage.name: Surrender to the Dreamlord
Heritage.description: You always found that dreaming (and daydreaming) in the wild offers visions and warning for the future.

Heritage.name: Sight of the Nocturnal Predator
Heritage.description: By closing your eyes for about three seconds and succeeding in a Willpower+Concentration+Heritage roll, you transform your eyes to those of a wolf, granting you excellent vision under even the faintest of light, removing any vision penalties. Note that a source of light is required, however faint, but won’t be able to gain any advantage in total darkness.

Heritage.name: Instruments of the Feral Hunter
Heritage.description: By concentrating for about three seconds and succeeding in a Willpower+Concentration+Heritage roll, you transform your teeth and nails into a wolf’s fangs (thrust ±0 pierce / reach 0m) and claws (swing +1 slash or thrust ±0 pierce, both reach 0m) granting you their damage types and bonuses, but not the skill (brawling) to use them.

Heritage.name: Assume the Form of the Great Beast
Heritage.description: By covering yourself in the wolf-skin, concentrating for about three seconds, and succeeding in a Willpower+Concentration+Heritage roll, you (and all the gear on you) transform into a dire wolf, gaining its physical characteristics (see below), but unable to perform any skills actions that require a human shape, e.g. speak, use equipment made for humans, etc. To transform back you need the same roll, but sometimes it feels difficult to “discipline” yourself. Dire wolf characteristics: +2 Agility, +2 Health, ±0 Strength, +4 Perception (all senses),2x short distance movement (acceleration), +4 Brawling, +4 Tracking (as long as you can smell), Tread the path lost to mankind (see above), Sight of the Nocturnal Predator (see above), and Instruments of the Feral Hunter (see above).

Traits.name: Lycanthropy
Traits.description: Since Ragusa, you notice that your reflection when human is distorted with your face looking closer to a wolf. Otherwise you can control the rest your body and the "beast's" urges, as long as you satisfy them (not spending too much time in enclosed spaces, hunting and eating raw meat, procreate with bitches in heat, etc).

Gear: pouch with 320 silver coins minted in Hungary
The Skin of the King of All Wolves (granting the abilities Sight of the Nocturnal Predator, Instruments of the Feral Hunter, Assume the Form of the Great Beast)
